decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (Application Form, Flood Risk Map, Location Plan received 15/12/11.
Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Drawing Numbers 01, 02, 03, 04, 05,  N289-A1-01 received 27/01/12.
Flood Risk Opinion, Ground Stability Report, received 22/02/12.)
 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted drawings, details of the materials to be used in the balustrade shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the development and thereafter the
approved details shall be implemented before the development is occupied and maintained thereafter.
Condition : 4 - The basement is not to be converted to a separate dwelling, nor used for habitable rooms
description: Excavation of a rear light well / stairwell to the basement, conversion of part of the basement to a habitable room and installation of stairs to the front of the house.
